competition: City of Wagga Open Rd 2- Stroke Mens

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Quinton Cooke (Howlong Country GC) - welcome to WWCC. We hope you enjoy the course and the hospitality.

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 pars on the bounce on holes 3, 4 & 5

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 4 pars in a row on holes 1-4 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Giveth and Taketh Away
stories.detail: nett birdie straight into a bogey on holes 4 & 5

stories.title: Speed Bump
stories.detail: nett birdie on hole 1, blow-up on hole 2 - the course corrects

stories.title: Three Over, Moving On
stories.detail: +3 on hole 3 - a moment of golf we shall never speak of again

stories.title: What On Earth Happened
stories.detail: +5 on hole 4 - the scorecard needs a moment to recover from that

stories.title: Away-Day Raid
stories.detail: Visitor from Ryde Parramatta GC sitting 9th - raiding the local silverware
